+ 
+ ### Component Architecture
+ - **Modular Design**: Each section is a separate component for maintainability
+ - **Responsive Layout**: Grid systems and Tailwind classes for mobile-first design
+ - **Animation Integration**: Framer Motion for enhanced user experience
+ - **Accessibility**: Proper ARIA labels, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation
+ 
+ ### Styling Approach
+ - **Consistent Section Wrapper**: Reusable `Section` component with size variants
+ - **Dark Theme**: Black background with accent colors (blue, emerald, purple, orange)
+ - **Typography Hierarchy**: Clear font sizing and weight differentiation
+ - **Visual Hierarchy**: Color-coded elements and strategic spacing
+ 
+ ### Performance Considerations
+ - **Lazy Loading**: Components load only when in viewport
+ - **Optimized Images**: Next.js Image component with proper sizing
+ - **Minimal Bundle**: Tree-shaking friendly imports
